summary: Narrow footpath inside the Botanic Gardens; no vehicle access, steep slope.

drivers.seclusion: Dense planted garden, but a public visitor area near the planetarium and information centre.
drivers.access_and_room: Ring sits on a narrow garden path in dense planting; no vehicles or tyre tracks, no room to stop a van.
drivers.traffic: Visitor car park about 97 m north; little road traffic at the ring.
drivers.convention: No sign anyone parks or stays; botanic gardens are likely closed overnight.

flags: Mapped gates nearby (109 m, 173 m, 186 m), not on only access
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over and around the path.
cannot_judge: Whether the mapped car park 97 m away allows overnight stays
